svg.title: Diagram: same task under three instruction conditions, scored with cost
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram. One task box feeds three equal lanes labelled No spec, Concise, and Longer, which converge on shared scoring for completion, tests, and regressions, with a side note that tokens and time sit beside quality. Animated reveal follows input to lanes to scoring; ink packets travel only along solid supported arrows. Design only; no results.

text.tspan: Design only — no results yet. Single-harness bound.
Labels from Gate-2 draft; C8 proposal, C2-C6 limits.
